$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for registry categorisation. Read by scripts/build-registry.mjs (which stamps `categories` onto every emitted registry item, per the shadcn registry-item schema) and by src/lib/categories.ts (which only supplies the human-readable titles/descriptions used by the site). Never categorise a component anywhere else.

categories.title: Foundation
categories.description: Layout, typography, and surface primitives — the structural floor every page composes on top of.

categories.title: A11y
categories.description: The keyboard + screen-reader + focus contract. SkipLink for WCAG 2.4.1, VisuallyHidden + FocusRing for the rest. Install via @interlace/a11y-starter.

categories.title: Form & input
categories.description: Text input, choice controls, and form composition. All inherit the WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.13 focus ring from preflight.

categories.title: Overlay
categories.description: Floating surfaces — dialogs, popovers, menus, tooltips. Base UI owns focus + dismissal; we own surface + motion.

categories.title: Feedback
categories.description: Communicate state — toast, alert, progress, skeleton, badge. Tone tokens (info / success / warning / danger) keep semantics consistent.

categories.title: Navigation
categories.description: Wayfinding — tabs, breadcrumb, pagination, headers, footers. Keyboard-equivalent everywhere (DESIGN_PRINCIPLES #10).

categories.title: Data display
categories.description: Stats, scorecards, avatars, scroll areas — the chrome around numbers and content.

categories.title: Blog & long-form
categories.description: Article-body surfaces — Callout, Prose, CodeBlock, Tag, TOC, article cards and templates. Install via @interlace/mdx-starter.

categories.title: Marketing
categories.description: Above-the-fold sections that sell — hero, pricing, FAQ, testimonial, feature grid, CTA.

categories.title: Other
categories.description: Uncategorised — falls here so a newly added component surfaces immediately without a manual step.

tierCategories.title: Primitives
tierCategories.description: Layer 1 — single-purpose components with a closed prop API. Installed flat into components/ui/.

tierCategories.title: Patterns
tierCategories.description: Layer 3 — multi-primitive compositions with a page-level job (hero, footer, pricing table).

tierCategories.title: Templates
tierCategories.description: Layer 4 — full-page surfaces that compose patterns inside SectionBoundaries. The fastest path to a new site.

tierCategories.title: Effects
tierCategories.description: Vendored magicui / aceternity motion components, promoted under the @interlace namespace.

tierCategories.title: Utilities
tierCategories.description: The cn() class merger and the useReducedMotion hook every interactive component depends on.

tierCategories.title: Theme
tierCategories.description: The five-stylesheet CSS baseline — tokens, foundation, preflight, bridge, brand palette.

tierCategories.title: Starters
tierCategories.description: Meta-installs that pull a curated set of items in one command.
